Name: Better Horses Epona
Author: SanguineFe
Description:
[img]https://orig00.deviantart.net/158b/f/2018/132/6/2/epona_by_inidis-dcbbaet.gif[/img]
This mod allows you to replace the vanilla horse with Link's steed Epona from the  Legend of Zelda.

The is based on the wonderful  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6]EPONA[/url] by Zhuria. I loved the design of that Epona but the animation bugged me.


The base of this Epona is the same as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1421/?]Better Horses[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5005122]SerialDollface[/url]

[size=3][i]This mod is simply a retexture and minor modification to Minakie's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/759/?]Real Life H[/url][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/759/?]orses[/url]. Minakie was the one that combined Avalitor's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/261/]Redesigned Horse Running Animation[/url] and Kitana Coldfire's [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/bigger-draft-horse-model-clydesdale-skin.112941/]Bigger Draft Horse Model[/url], I just wanted Epona to join in on the betterfication.



Update: I have hopefully fixed the issue with the content patcher files. Let me know if you still have issues.[/i][/size]
